cpython_ssl.finding: Context construction selects TLS methods; public protocol choices do not select DTLS or QUIC. CA-file loading uses SSL_CTX_load_verify_locations; in-memory PEM certificates use PEM_read_bio_X509 then X509_STORE_add_cert. The shown API offers no DANE enable/TLSA setup, CMS encryption, SuiteB certificate-flag setter or arbitrary EVP cipher encryption.

httpx.finding: verify=True creates Python default SSL context from configured certificate file/directory or certifi. Optional supplied SSLContext and transports require separate review.

libpq18.finding: initialize_SSL uses a TLS context and SSL_connect for PostgreSQL client traffic. Root loading uses standard verify-path/file APIs. No DANE/QUIC/DTLS mode is selected by this path. SSLv23_method is an historical alias for TLS_method, not evidence that SSLv2 is used. Engine, password hooks and caller-supplied OpenSSL hooks can extend native behavior; they require effective configuration review. Exact wheel libpq release remains pending.

openssl_ca.finding: The certificate/CRL file loader invokes PEM_X509_INFO_read_bio_ex with a NULL second argument. It therefore does not meet the existing-stack condition for CVE-2026-107493, even when a CA PEM file is malformed.

openssl_alias.finding: SSLv23_method is the compatibility TLS_method alias; QUIC/DTLS require their own protocol method selection.

cpython_hash.finding: Hashlib provides digest, HMAC and key-derivation operations; it does not make arbitrary provider cipher encryption available merely because libcrypto is linked.
